summary: Review fixes to the immutable image edition's update, pool rollout, Controller swap, layers, publisher, installer, CI and lab work (development only, simulated hosts). Update engine: an already staged release is not staged again; a free-space check (insufficient_space, enabled on-demand layers counted, layers_unavailable) before any download; cancel refused while an activate or rollback runs; a failed arm is undone on every disk (arm_incomplete when it cannot be, disarm on cancel or activate), a failed reboot is recorded (reboot_failed) and repeated by activate, a partial rollback is rollback_incomplete and repeatable; versioned trust documents (trust_gap); nex-update exit codes. Pool rollout: hosts already on the release are current, control request_id and force, durable abort (abort_cleanup_pending, abort_not_pending), vm_* pause codes with a bounded retry window (retry_started_at), quorum gate before rollback_host, bounded passes. Controller swap: ownership guards before shutdown, stage_failed and insufficient_storage, resume when libvirt autostarted the old image. Layers: in_use when metadata is unreadable; boot-time sysusers/tmpfiles/udev. System-disk replace refused on image hosts. Publisher: trust version and expiry rules, --allow-orphaned-signatures, floor re-sign, release-directory checks, full lock check. Installer: paced initrd reboot unit, cleanup trap, dev release notes. CI and labs: pinned setup-go, QEMU prerequisites, workspace locator, sign-release marker, loop-device cleanup. New test and helper files: stubs_test.go (nexupdate, controller), nex-update main_test.go, nex-hostimage main_test.go, layers_test.go, md_replace_image_test.go, installer-image-env.py, test_lab_drivers.py, test_image_lab_helpers.py, ci-host-workspace.sh, nex-initrd-reboot.service and nex-initrd-reboot-paced.service.

guide.reason: update-a-pool.md, deploy-controller-appliance.md and the roll-back and software-update pages describe the corrected behaviour and stay marked unverified; no workflow was walked through on a running Controller or image host.

api.reason: No route is added. Status and refusal codes, the pool control body (force), pause codes, the host record field retry_started_at, the update failure codes and the publisher CLI are documented in docs/API.md and the generated references; docs/api/*.json were regenerated and tests/test_api_contract.py covers the refusal lists.

roadmap.reason: Defect fixes inside phases that are proposed and not yet accepted; no milestone changes.

state.reason: Core's update engine, pool coordinator and swap engine keep the records; the Controller only relays requests and shows what hosts report.
state.record: Per-host /var/lib/nex/image/state.json, the pool master's pool-update.json and the swap journal, all written by Core; unchanged in location.

verification.method: Focused Go tests per package (hostimage, nexupdate, vmhost, agent, localcore, protocol, controller) and Python unit tests (update publisher, image lock, release version, image layout and installer, CI shape, lab helpers, API contract) were run by the fixing lanes with fake peers and fake hosts; several fixes were mutation-checked. No Docker, KVM or QEMU lab was run for these fixes and the initrd reboot change has not been booted.
